objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution, archiving, revision, validity extension, override, reactivation and translation.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number included in the document name by default for each type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Included in the document name.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and is documented for released versions.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document and used in workflows and lifecycle.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used for user group assignment of reader authorizations.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization and workflow participant assignment.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used for additional personal change rights and workflow participant assignment.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization and workflow participant assignment.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization and workflow participant assignment.

attributes.name: releaser_translation
attributes.description: Attribute used for personal authorization and workflow participant assignment including translation.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the validity period count starts.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period defined for each document type for checking extended validity.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date resulting from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration defined for each document type for archived documents.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Type selected when creating a new document; document templates, validity extension period and archive duration can be defined for each document type.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the document type.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation used in document naming.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period for checking extended validity defined for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Archive duration defined for each document type.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template selectable when creating new document objects; one or more can be defined for each document type.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment not subject to the release cycle of the main document and without its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with the release of the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for a document created and managed without affecting the content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person involved as reader, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, initiator or recipient.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group assigned to documents for read or change rights, distribution, authorizations or archive access.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change rights assigned specifically to documents at group and person level.

objs.name: role
objs.description: System role that provides users with functions according to their area of application.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow status, document release, change proposals, validity extension, override or acknowledgement.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to the document to be checked when validity is near expiry.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Workflow-supported confirmation requested from persons and users of assigned User Groups upon release.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific view filled using distribution groups and listing documents relevant to a user.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search available for documents in the system.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system for which a document can be specified as visible or not.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk to which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data to which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example to which documents can be automatically linked.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: New document is created in the system by attachment of a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_type
evts.description: Corresponding document type is selected when attaching a new information object.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Document template can be selected when creating new objects.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Pure object cover can be created.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: New documents can be generated based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Properties editing of the document is opened and metadata can be maintained.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Document content is edited with the editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Document is saved.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Saved document is automatically converted to PDF by the system.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Current version is displayed on the web as a PDF.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Group and person-related authorizations are assigned in the Control release category.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Participants in the release process are assigned via document properties.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is added to a document when attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is released directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information is published directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Additional information can be deleted again directly.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is added to a document when attaching a new information object to the document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is modified and triggers a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Attachment is marked for archiving and archived with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Approval process is initiated after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs in the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: complete_review_task
evts.description: Reviewer completes review task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: complete_release_task
evts.description: Releaser completes release task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Rejection during review or release cancels the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new document version is created in editing status when released document is revised or specific changes occur.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author-right employee creates a Change proposal for a document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Change proposal is scheduled for implementation and creates a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Completed Change proposals are no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension thirty days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Request for validity extension is processed with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Additional validity is declared; request for validity extension is deleted and Valid until is updated.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Validity extension process is automatically terminated when a new revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: User with write access creates a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Workflow for processing the request for AKS is started automatically.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Document is declared Out of force; last valid approved version gets Out of force status and rights are revoked except archive group.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Document is physically deleted after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Business Admin group creates a request for reactivation and selects the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Workflow for reactivation is started automatically.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Invalidated document is revalidated by creating a new version, setting authorizations and restoring status except version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Attachments archived with the document are reactivated.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Distribution lists are maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Assigned users and users of assigned User Groups are informed by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Persons and users of assigned User Groups are requested by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_all_acknowledgements_confirmed
evts.description: Author team receives notification as soon as all persons maintained in Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: User and role-specific dashboards are filled by defining distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: select_document_from_dashboard
evts.description: Document is selected from the dashboard and detailed information is displayed.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Role-specific evaluation report or search is run using selection parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Translated version is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients are specified.

evts.name: create_local_document_addition
evts.description: A new document is created in a client to make a local addition, describe the change or extension and create a reference to the original document.
